lines.text: You are in the kitchen, making lunch, and your agent is somewhere deep in a refactor.
Then it hits a decision it cannot make alone, and stops, waiting on a question for you.
And you would never know. Your laptop is closed, and your phone stays silent on the counter.
An hour later the agent is still waiting, the whole refactor stalled over one simple question.
Agent R Q pushes the request to your phone the moment it appears, instead of waiting for you to look.
Your phone buzzes on the counter, and the question is right there on the lock screen.
You wipe your hands, and tap a reply, with one finger, without opening a laptop.
The agent hears it instantly, over a live stream, with no timer and no check in between.
It carries on with the refactor, exactly where it paused, and keeps the old session format.
And lunch is saved, because the whole interruption cost you about ten seconds.
You stay in control without being chained to a screen, because the agent finds you when it matters.
Where were you the last time an agent needed you? Tell us the funniest place, and try Agent R Q dot com.
